title: India can emerge as global SAF export hub with low-carbon ethanol advantage: Triveni Engineering CEO
description: India is poised to become a sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) export hub, leveraging its significant ethanol surplus and lower carbon intensity compared to rivals.  With potential SAF plants operational by 2029, India aims to supply Southeast Asia and the Middle East, capitalizing on its competitive advantages in ethanol production.

title: ADB approves $108 mn loan to Mizoram to strengthen public healthcare system
description: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) has approved a $108 million results-based loan to support the Government of Mizoram in strengthening its public health care system and achieving universal health coverage.

title: Ahmedabad plane crash: Six months on, college hostel lies in ruins, sans bustle of students
description: Six months after the AI-171 plane crash, the B J Medical College hostel complex in Ahmedabad stands as a haunting reminder. Charred walls and burnt trees replaced student life. Remnants of daily life are scattered across the site. The area remains abandoned and entry is prohibited. Residents near the site still recall the incident with fear.

title: From Europe to India, IATA sounds alarm over rising GPS interference in flights
description: Global airlines are facing a growing concern as GPS spoofing and jamming incidents rise, demanding increased pilot vigilance. IATA data shows a significant increase in GPS loss rates, with projections indicating a continued upward trend. These interferences, often a byproduct of military activities, are impacting major airports worldwide, including in India.

title: Nearly 4 GW of solar capacity in Rajasthan hit by transmission constraints
description: About 4,300 MW of solar power capacity in Rajasthan is facing complete daytime curtailment due to a shortage of transmission infrastructure, putting projects worth nearly Rs 20,000 crore at risk, industry sources said.

title: NCLAT rejects SEBI's plea to recover penalty from Annies Apparel
description: The National Company Law Appellate Tribunal has rejected SEBI's attempt to recover a penalty from Annies Apparel. The tribunal ruled that claims cannot be filed after a company enters liquidation under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code. This decision upholds the principle that all claims are frozen on the liquidation commencement date.

title: BMW to bolster MINI brand; looks to drive in new models, expand sales
description: BMW plans to expand its MINI portfolio in India next year to meet growing demand beyond metro cities. The company will also double its sales network to include smaller towns like Jaipur and Lucknow. This expansion aims to build the MINI community and cater to a broader customer base, with a target of at least double-digit growth for the brand.

title: Parliamentary panel recommends easing clearances for underground coal mining projects
description: A parliamentary panel wants simpler rules for underground coal mining.  This method has low environmental impact.  Current complex processes cause project delays.  The government aims for 100 million tonnes of coal from underground mines by 2030.  Simplifying procedures will help achieve this target.  This will also preserve land and forests.  The panel also recommended a single-window clearance for open-cast mining.

title: Parliamentary Panel urges diversification of crude oil sources to cut geopolitical risks
description: India imports nearly 89 percent of its crude oil. A parliamentary committee highlights this dependence and rising geopolitical risks. It urges the government to diversify oil sources and strengthen risk management. This includes bolstering strategic reserves and developing alternative import routes. Institutionalizing hedging and flexible contracts is also recommended to ensure energy security against future shocks.

title: JioHotstar loads up on South originals as post-merger viewership explodes
description: JioHotstar is significantly boosting its South India presence with a Rs 4,000 crore investment over five years, commissioning 25 new regional titles. The platform aims to build viewing habits through long-running episodic shows and by doubling down on reality content, following strong post-merger momentum and consumer response.

title: Food Fighters: The voices urging India to look closer at what’s on its plate
description: Meet the food activists who are spearheading the battle to bring clarity and awareness to what India consumes— from Dr Sivaranjani Santosh who has campaigned against the mislabelling of ORS, to Dr Arun Gupta who is calling for front-of-pack labels, to Revant Himatsingka who is exhorting people to check ingredients

title: Amid fading FAME surge, charging woes, GST 2.0 ICE kickstart, electric 2-wheelers need new direction
description: Legacy manufacturers continue to anchor the market. Hero MotoCorp retained its leadership, followed by Honda and TVS, signalling a return to steady demand for petrol models even as the festive surge tapered off. The resurgence underscores the surprising reality that while EVs were expected to disrupt ICE dominance by now, it is the ICE market that appears far more predictable and resilient, experts said.

title: Higher Edu Reforms: New bill welcome, actions must align
description: India is set to introduce the Vikasit Bharat Vidya Adhikshan Bill, 2025. This new law will reshape higher education regulation. The goal is to move away from outdated, control-focused rules. The focus will shift to academic quality and real outcomes. This reform aims to foster innovation and improve standards across institutions.

title: After fake ID crackdown, IRCTC daily new accounts down to 5000 from one lakh: Railways
description: Indian Railways has successfully reduced new user IDs on the IRCTC website. A new system verifies user identities, leading to a drop from nearly one lakh to about 5,000 new IDs daily. This crackdown has deactivated over 3 crore fake accounts. Another 2.7 crore are suspended or flagged for suspicious activity.

title: 90% of IndiGo's flight operations have returned to normal: Union minister Murlidhar Mohol
description: IndiGo's flight operations are nearly back to normal. Union Minister Murlidhar Mohol stated that about 90 percent of flights have resumed. The airline faced cancellations due to new safety rules. A committee will be formed to assign responsibility for the disruptions. Passengers experienced losses.

title: Local cuisine to be served in Vande Bharat trains and progressively introduced in all trains
description: Indian Railways is set to introduce local cuisine in Vande Bharat trains to enhance passenger experience. This initiative will progressively expand to all trains.  A strong crackdown on fake ticket booking identities is yielding results.  Indian Railways has deactivated over 3 crore fake accounts.  Efforts are underway to ensure easy ticket booking for all genuine users.

title: Goa, Kerala remain top winter destinations for Indian travellers: Report
description: Winter travel is popular for Indians, with about 55 percent planning trips. Goa and Kerala are top destinations. Travelers seek holidays, relaxation, and cultural experiences. Younger generations are driving interest in spiritual sites. Many travel with partners, friends, or multi-generational families. Indians are exploring domestic destinations for new experiences.

title: Women sommeliers are cracking male-dominated wine world open
description: Women sommeliers are stepping into a more inclusive arena, finding their professional environment significantly more inviting. Despite the historical trend of men taking the majority of accolades, many female sommeliers are encouraged by fewer sexist experiences in their careers. As societal attitudes evolve, nearly 50% of aspiring sommeliers in France are now women, signaling a transformative era.

title: IndiGo flight suffers tail strike while landing at Ranchi airport
description: An IndiGo flight from Bhubaneswar to Ranchi encountered a tail strike upon landing at Ranchi airport on Friday evening. The aircraft's tail touched the runway, causing a jolt for the approximately 70 passengers on board. Fortunately, all passengers were safe and unharmed. The flight was grounded due to technical reasons, leading to cancellations and rescheduling of journeys.

title: SAIL posts 14 per cent growth in sales in Apr-Nov
description: Steel Authority of India Limited, SAIL, achieved a 14 percent increase in sales for April to November 2025. This growth reached 12.7 million tonnes. The company navigated price pressures and demand volatility effectively. Retail sales also saw a significant rise of 13 percent. November alone showed a 27 percent overall sales jump. Retail sales surged by 69 percent in November.

title: Air India Express pilot hiring plan sparks internal unrest as carrier scouts IndiGo talent
description: Air India Express pilots are unhappy with new recruitment plans. They believe hiring more pilots will reduce their flying hours and pay. This comes as the airline seeks experienced captains, potentially from IndiGo. Pilots argue the airline already has enough crew for its current fleet. The situation highlights challenges in managing staff morale during the airline group's expansion.

title: Agentic AI transforms banks frontline sales, boosts productivity and revenue: Report
description: Agentic AI is revolutionizing frontline banking sales by automating complex workflows and administrative tasks. This technology enables relationship managers to focus on high-value client interactions, leading to significant revenue increases and cost reductions. Banks are adopting agentic AI as a new operating model for enhanced productivity and client engagement.

title: IndiGo estimates over Rs 500 crore compensation payout after massive flight cancellations
description: IndiGo anticipates a compensation payout exceeding Rs 500 crores for customers affected by flight cancellations within 24 hours of departure and those severely stranded at airports. The airline is prioritizing efficient refund processing, with most already completed, and will reach out to impacted customers in January for compensation.

title: Delhi Airport issues advisory as heavy smog chokes capital, passengers asked to check with airlines
description: Delhi experienced a severe smog situation on Saturday, with air quality reaching the 'severe' category. Despite low visibility, Indira Gandhi International Airport confirmed normal flight operations, advising passengers to check with airlines. Low wind speeds are contributing to the persistent pollution, with moderate fog expected to continue.

title: IndiGo Airline back on track; resumes operations across 138 destinations, operates around 2050 flights
IndiGo flight status December 13: Check latest cancellations and updates from major airports for today
description: IndiGo flight status today: The IndiGo crisis continued on Saturday as four flights were cancelled at the Coimbatore Airport on December 13. The Chandigarh Airport also saw cancellations and Delhi Airport said all flight operations are presently normal. On Friday, IndiGo cancelled 200 flights from Delhi and Bengaluru airports amid the ongoing disruptions. Multiple flights were cancelled at the Goa and Chennai airports today.

title: How media industry wants to regulate GenAI training
description: Amid rising concerns, India's media industry is highlighting the risks of unregulated AI training exploiting copyrighted works. In response, the government is crafting a strategic framework to harmonise AI advancements with intellectual property rights.

title: IITs revamp curricula to keep pace with rapid tech shifts
description: To align with the fast-paced world of tech and business, Indian Institutes of Technology are revamping their curricula. Students will benefit from a tailored learning experience, with opportunities to join and leave programs as their interests evolve. New interdisciplinary avenues promise a blend of subjects for a well-rounded education.

title: Tesla US sales drop to nearly 4-year low in November despite launch of cheaper versions
description: Making a success of the more affordable variants, called Standard, is important for Tesla and a test of its strategy for how to keep selling cars and bring in revenue as it transitions to making robotaxis and building humanoid robots, which are the core reasons investors value the company at $1.4 trillion. EV sales have taken a hit broadly since the end of September when the Trump administration ended $7,500 federal tax credits. To combat the fall in demand, Tesla in October launched stripped-down versions of its Model Y SUV and Model 3 compact sedan, priced about $5,000 below the previous base models.

title: Delhi HC refuses to stay order allowing Dr Reddy's to export semaglutide
description: The Delhi High Court has taken a firm stand by rejecting Novo Nordisk's plea to pause a prior ruling. This decision empowers Dr Reddy's Laboratories to manufacture and ship its Semaglutide drug to countries free from Novo Nordisk's patent. The court described Novo Nordisk's arguments as lacking strength, with the next hearing scheduled for January 15.

title: Himachal drug cos under stop orders found operational
description: Himachal Pradesh's drug regulation bodies came across a concerning trend: numerous pharmaceutical companies were found to be operating illicitly, despite official directives to cease manufacturing after failing quality evaluations. Inspections indicated these firms may not have stopped production as mandated.

title: IndiGo parent moves HC against double customs duty on reimported parts
description: InterGlobe Aviation, the parent of IndiGo, has approached the Delhi High Court. The company is seeking a refund of ₹900 crore paid as customs duty. This duty was levied on aircraft engines and parts reimported after repairs abroad. InterGlobe argues this is an unconstitutional double levy. The court will hear the case on December 19.

title: Private companies may be kept out of Uranium mining
description: New amendments to India's atomic energy bill may reserve uranium mining exclusively for government companies. Private firms might be excluded from this critical sector. The proposed changes to the Atomic Energy Act, 1962, and the Civil Liability for Nuclear Damages Act, 2010, are expected soon. This move comes despite earlier considerations to allow private participation in local uranium production.

title: Civil Aviation Minister Naidu defends airfare deregulation
description: Civil Aviation Minister K Rammohan Naidu stated the Centre can cap airfares in emergencies. However, he clarified fare caps are not a permanent fix for rising ticket prices. The government has imposed limits based on flight duration following IndiGo's mass flight cancellations.

title: Tata Steel to boost capacity by 50% to maintain market lead
description: Tata Steel plans a nearly 50% capacity expansion in India to defend market share and secure raw materials, with most capex expected from internal accruals. This strategic move aims to align new capacities with anticipated demand growth post-FY29, ensuring profitability and maintaining a healthy balance sheet.

title: Hot Wheels! Motown stays in fast lane as November show wholesale dispatches rise in double-digits
description: Vehicle sales saw a significant jump in November. Car, two-wheeler and three-wheeler wholesale dispatches to dealers increased strongly year-on-year. This surge followed the festive season, indicating continued consumer demand. Manufacturers are building stocks to meet demand during the upcoming marriage season.

title: Coal acquired via auction open to any use
description: The Centre has amended its Coal (Non-Regulated Sector) Linkage Policy of 2016, enabling the export of coal from blocks with existing linkages. A new policy, CoalSETU, will allow end-use free purchase of coal for any industrial use and export, excluding traders. Coking coal will not be offered due to domestic scarcity.

title: India second-biggest Russian fossil fuel buyer after China
description: India significantly increased its purchase of Russian fossil fuels in November. This surge placed India as the second-largest importer, following China. The rise was fueled by higher imports of crude oil, coal, and refined oil products. This comes as the United States continues to pressure India to reduce these purchases.

title: Railways working on cost-cut plan ahead of higher wage bill
description: Indian Railways is preparing for increased wage expenses from the Eighth Pay Commission. The national transporter is focusing on cost reductions in maintenance, procurement, and energy. These measures aim to strengthen finances and improve operating performance. Anticipated savings from electrification and higher freight earnings will support the additional fund requirement.

title: Telecom operators ask govt to rationalise spectrum valuation
description: Telecom operators are calling for lower spectrum prices and better payment terms. They want reserve prices cut to 50% of valuation to boost auction participation. Operators also requested longer spectrum assignment periods and a longer moratorium on payments. They believe restricting spectrum supply creates artificial scarcity.

title: Adani Energy Solutions acquires KPS III HVDC Transmission Ltd
description: Adani Energy Solutions Ltd has acquired KPS III HVDC Transmission Ltd. This move strengthens AESL's strategy for shareholder value. The project will help evacuate 2.5 GW of renewable energy. This is part of the Khavda renewable energy park's expansion. The acquisition was completed on December 12, 2025. The deal was done at face value.

title: SBI passes RBI rate cut benefit to borrowers, reduces lending rate by 25 bps
description: State Bank of India and Indian Overseas Bank have reduced lending rates by 25 basis points, mirroring the RBI's policy rate cut. This move makes loans cheaper for existing and new borrowers, impacting EMIs for retail, MSME, and corporate clients. MCLR and Base Rate have also been lowered.

title: Novo Nordisk bets on cheaper Ozempic to dominate India’s booming weight-loss market
description: Novo Nordisk has launched Ozempic in India at a competitive price, aiming to capture a significant share of the growing weight-loss market. Leveraging its established dominance in diabetes care and insulin leadership, the company seeks to accelerate adoption of its GLP-1 therapy, positioning it against rivals like Eli Lilly.

title: IRCTC begins branded meal service trials on select Vande Bharat, Amrit Bharat trains
description: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC) is conducting trials to improve on-board catering by de-linking meal production and service. This initiative aims to partner with branded food players to offer fresh, hygienic, and diverse meal options on select Vande Bharat and Amrit Bharat trains. Passenger feedback from these trials will guide future enhancements to railway dining services.

title: NCLAT asks IL&FS to not create third-party rights over headquarters property
description: The NCLAT has directed IL&FS not to create any third-party interest over its Mumbai headquarters. This comes after Brookfield's appeal against a recent NCLT order. The NCLAT also asked Brookfield to renew its performance guarantee within a month. IL&FS must file its reply by January 6, and Brookfield its rejoinder by January 16.

title: Another Mumbai bungalow to make way for redevelopment with Rs 164-cr deal
description: A vintage bungalow in Santacruz west has been sold for Rs 164 crore. This prime property will be redeveloped into luxury apartments.  Such deals are common in the Bandra-Khar-Santacruz belt.  Developers are acquiring these plots for premium residential projects.  Demand for luxury homes remains strong.  This sale highlights the ongoing transformation of standalone homes into new housing stock.

title: IndiGo faces nearly Rs 59 cr penalty in relation to GST; airline to contest order
description: IndiGo faces a significant penalty of nearly Rs 59 crore related to GST. The airline has been issued a demand notice along with a penalty for the financial year 2020-21. IndiGo believes the order is erroneous and plans to contest it. The company has received advice from external tax advisors.

title: IRFC aims to cross loan sanction of Rs 60,000 crore in Q3
description: Outlining long-term strategic vision for the Navratna CPSE at its 40th Foundation Day, Dubey said this milestone signals the organisation's strong fundamentals, disciplined financial architecture and renewed strategic focus, setting the tone for the next phase of the company's growth story.

title: ICC, JioStar clarify on media rights deal after reports of exit ahead of T20 World Cup
description: The ICC and JioStar have jointly refuted reports suggesting JioStar's withdrawal from their India media-rights agreement. Both organizations affirmed the contract remains valid and in full force, with JioStar committed to its obligations for upcoming ICC events. This statement counters claims of financial losses and a new bidding process for future rights.

title: IndiGo moves Delhi HC over Rs 900 crore customs duty refund on re-import of aircraft parts: Report
description: IndiGo has filed a petition in the Delhi High Court seeking a refund of over ₹900 crore in customs duty paid on aircraft engines and parts re-imported after overseas repairs. The airline argues the duty is unconstitutional and constitutes a double levy. The case was adjourned as one judge recused herself due to her son's employment with IndiGo.

title: Nestle India appoints former Pernod Ricard HR head Nitu Bhushan as its new HR chief
description: Nestle India is bringing in Nitu Bhushan as its new Head of Human Resources. She joins from Pernod Ricard. The company also announced other leadership transitions. Svetlana Boldina will move to a new role, and Satish Srinivasan will retire. Jagdeep Singh Marahar will take over technical operations. These changes occur as Nestle India faces stiff competition.

title: Godrej Properties sells over Rs 2,600-crore homes in 1st year of operation in Hyderabad, looks to expand biz
description: Godrej Properties has achieved significant success in Hyderabad, selling housing properties worth Rs 2,600 crore in its first year. The company is now looking to expand its business in the city due to huge growth opportunities. This strong performance is driving aggressive land acquisition for future projects.

title: Jaipur discom JVVNL intensifies revenue recovery amid mounting dues
description: Jaipur discom JVVNL is stepping up efforts to recover outstanding dues and combat electricity theft.  The discom has identified high-default areas and is implementing strict measures.  Vigilance operations are also underway to curb power theft. These actions aim to stabilize finances and ensure reliable power supply across Rajasthan.  The discom seeks to send a clear message against non-payment and theft.

title: Air India may operate 275 more flights in December as IndiGo faces capacity cut
description: Air India is offering to operate up to 275 additional flights this month to compensate for IndiGo's 10% capacity cut, ordered by the aviation ministry to rebalance routes during peak season. The ministry is reallocating some of IndiGo's routes to Air India, AI Express, and Akasa to prevent passenger suffering and curb IndiGo's market dominance.

title: Navi Mumbai airport: Bids invited for third runway techno-commercial feasibility study consultant
description: CIDCO is seeking a consultant for a techno-commercial feasibility study. This study will assess the viability of a third runway at Navi Mumbai International Airport. The aim is to prepare for future air traffic growth. The consultancy will take six months. This is a crucial step for long-term capacity planning.

title: Banks advised to link MSME loans to external benchmark by RBI: Govt
description: The Reserve Bank of India has directed banks to link MSME loans to an external benchmark with a three-month reset clause to improve monetary policy transmission. Existing borrowers can switch to this regime under mutually agreed terms.

title: Delhi to run 11 hospitals under PPP model, add over 10,000 beds
description: Delhi government is moving forward with a plan to operate eleven government hospitals through a public-private partnership. Most of these hospitals are currently under construction.

title: SBI aims to double YONO app users to 20 cr in 2 years, plans significant investment: Chairman
description: State Bank of India is launching YONO 2.0, a new version of its mobile banking app. The bank aims to double its YONO user base to 20 crore customers within the next two years. This upgrade offers enhanced digital experiences and seamless integration across banking channels. SBI also anticipates strong credit growth driven by its RAM segment.

title: TVs may be costlier from January due to memory chips shortage, weak rupee
description: Television prices are set to increase by 3 to 4 percent starting next January. This rise is driven by escalating costs of essential memory chips and a weakening Indian Rupee. Major components for LED TVs are imported, making the industry vulnerable to currency fluctuations. Manufacturers are already informing dealers about the impending price adjustments.

title: No scientific link found between COVID-19 vaccination, sudden deaths in young adults: AIIMS study
description: Sudden death in young adults is a significant concern requiring targeted public health strategies, the study said, underlying coronary artery disease remains the leading cause and that respiratory and unexplained deaths warrant further investigation.

title: India's gems, jewellery exports in November grew 20 pc to USD 2.5 bn: GJEPC
description: India's gems and jewellery exports saw a significant jump of 19.64 percent in November, reaching USD 2.5 billion. This growth was driven by strong demand in markets like Hong Kong, China, and the Middle East. Cut and polished diamond exports also increased substantially. Gold studded jewellery shipments surged due to high demand for job works.

title: TV prices likely to rise from January as chip crunch and falling rupee squeeze makers
description: Television prices are set to increase by 3 to 4 percent starting next January. This rise is driven by escalating costs of essential memory chips and a weakening Indian Rupee. Major components for LED TVs are imported, making the industry vulnerable to currency fluctuations. Manufacturers are already informing dealers about the impending price adjustments.

title: Kuwait sees fair oil price at $60-$68 a barrel, says oil minister
description: The recent decline in oil prices was unexpected, Kuwait's Oil Minister Tariq Al-Roumi said on the sidelines of the Organization of Arab Petroleum Exporting Countries' (OAPEC) ministerial meeting in Kuwait.

title: Airports Authority's high-frequency radar to be relocated, will unlock land for affordable housing in Dahisar: Union Min Rammohan Naidu
description: Mumbai's Dahisar radar will move to Gorai. This unlocks hundreds of acres for affordable housing. The decision follows a meeting with the Civil Aviation Ministry and Maharashtra government. Cabinet approval is sought for early construction. This move will allow redevelopment of old buildings.

title: Fresh policy push to unlock Mumbai’s long-stalled Pagdi buildings
description: The country’s financial capital has over 19,000 pagdi buildings, with more than 13,000 still pending redevelopment, many in prime central areas where land is scarce. The move is expected to generate renewed investor interest and potential development opportunities across these high-value precincts.

title: New Education Bill to replace UGC, AICTE with regulatory council; Centre to hold more power
description: Marking a major shift, the Centre will also ensure that the new regulator is divested of all funding/grant mechanisms, which will instead be handled by the Union education ministry.

title: Fresh push to unlock Mumbai’s long-stalled Pagdi buildings redevelopment
description: The country’s financial capital has over 19,000 pagdi buildings, with more than 13,000 still pending redevelopment, many in prime central areas where land is scarce. The move is expected to generate renewed investor interest and potential development opportunities across these high-value precincts.

title: NCLT's valuation flags cloud IL&FS HQ sale
description: In a recent order, the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) rejected the proposed sale of two IL&FS-owned commercial properties -Mafatlal Chambers and Trade World -citing undervaluation.

title: Bombay High Court rules in favour of AB InBev in trademark case
description: The court ruled that using the "COX 5001" trademark amounts to "passing off", a term used in intellectual property rights (IPR) law referring to making a false representation that is likely to mislead someone into believing that the goods or services come from another source.

title: Tata Capital anchors Rs 2,300-crore refinancing of Jayaswal Neco debt
description: The refinancing was anchored by Tata Capital with a commitment of about ₹800 crore, alongside Investec at ₹300 crore. Other lenders and investors in the syndicate include Vivriti Capital (₹200 crore), Hero FinCorp, Hero Corp, DSP, Oxyzo and a clutch of family offices, taking the total deal size to around ₹2,300 crore.

title: Regulatory hurdles likely to delay rollout of satcom internet services
description: So far, Starlink, Eutelsat OneWeb, and Jio Satellite have completed most of the licensing and space-regulatory steps, including obtaining the Global Mobile Personal Communication by Satellite (GMPCS) licence, and approvals from space-regulatory body In-SPACe. Commercial launch, however, hinges on the spectrum allocation based on pricing rules, and compliance with security and capacity rules.

title: Cheap copper imports hurting domestic manufacturing, says industry body
description: Cheap copper imports are hurting Indian manufacturers. The Indian Primary Copper Producers Association is calling for government action. They want safeguard duties and limits on overseas shipments. Investments in domestic production are at risk. The association highlights issues with the India-UAE CEPA and an inflated tariff rate quota. Immediate intervention is sought to protect the industry.

title: Parliamentary panel flags oil import dependence, urges diversification amid geopolitical risks
description: A parliamentary committee has highlighted India's significant reliance on crude oil imports, nearly 89%, and the escalating geopolitical risks. It urged the government to diversify supply sources and bolster risk management, including hedging and flexible contracts, to counter global disruptions and ensure energy security.

title: Lending rates moving lower to raise pressure on bank NIMs
description: Bankers said the move will delay margin recovery since they cannot cut deposit rates sharply due to stiff competition from alternative investment avenues such as mutual funds.

title: ICAI bats for division of audit onus; signals truce with NFRA after a year
description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India is set to propose a clear division of responsibility between principal auditors of corporate groups and those auditing subsidiaries. This move aims to ensure financial statement quality and establish accountability. The recommendations will be submitted to the corporate affairs ministry and the National Financial Reporting Authority.

title: Reliance in talks for a bite of Udhaiyams, set to take on Tata, iD Fresh, MTR
description: Reliance Consumer Products is in advanced talks to acquire a majority stake in Udhaiyams Agro Foods. This company makes staples, snacks, and ready-to-cook breakfast mixes. The deal is expected to be mid-sized. Reliance aims to tap into regional markets first before a national rollout. This strategy mirrors previous acquisitions.

title: Vi may get 4-5 years of AGR dues moratorium; dues could be halved
description: Under the current schedule, Vi needs to pay more than ₹18,000 crore next March as the first instalment after the end of a moratorium on AGR payments the government had given to telcos in 2021. This was not interest-free, resulting in the arrears increasing every year.

title: Mizuho looks to wrap up Avendus acquisition this week
description: Board of the homegrown investment bank is scheduled to meet on Tuesday to okay transaction valuing I-banker at Rs 5,900 crore. KKR looks to make 3.5x rupee return from 9 year old investment.

title: Delhi weather update: IndiGo, SpiceJet warn of possible flight delays as fog hits visibility
description: IndiGo warned passengers of possible delays at Delhi airport after the season’s first winter fog reduced visibility. The airline said departures may take longer as operations adjust, advised travelers to allow extra time due to slower road traffic, and assured that teams are monitoring conditions and prioritising safety.

title: Delhi weather update: IndiGo, Air India warn of possible flight delays as fog hits visibility
description: IndiGo, Air India, and SpiceJet warned of potential flight delays at Delhi airport due to the season’s first winter fog, which has reduced visibility. Airlines advised passengers to check flight status and allow extra travel time, as poor visibility may affect departures and arrivals, especially for flights not equipped for advanced CAT III landing operations that allow safe landings in dense fog.

title: Vodafone Idea in for a big breather as it may pay half of Rs 83,000 cr dues after 4-5-year moratorium
description: Under the current schedule, Vi needs to pay more than ₹18,000 crore next March as the first instalment after the end of a moratorium on AGR payments the government had given to telcos in 2021. This was not interest-free, resulting in the arrears increasing every year.

title: Southeast Asia turning into a major market, excited about opportunities in India: Cathay Cargo Director
description: Cathay Cargo sees Southeast Asia as a key growth market. India offers exciting prospects for the air freight sector. The company currently operates multiple freighter flights to India weekly. Future expansion in India may involve dedicated freighters to cities like Hyderabad, Bengaluru, and Ahmedabad. Co-terminalisation is identified as a crucial factor for this expansion.

title: Axis Bank to hire 50 private bankers as wealth boom intensifies in India
description: Axis Bank is expanding its private banking and wealth management services, hiring 50 senior bankers and planning to launch investment funds from GIFT City. This move aims to cater to India's growing wealthy population, with the bank extending its reach to tier 2 cities and beyond to capture rising demand.

title: Delhi Weather: 40 flights cancelled from Delhi Airport amid dense fog in national capital, 4 diverted
description: Dense fog blanketed Delhi-NCR on Monday. Delhi Airport announced 40 flight cancellations and 2 diversions. Several airlines warned passengers about disruptions. Flight operations remain impacted. Airport officials are assisting passengers across terminals. This is the first major fog spell of winter affecting North India's airports.

title: Indigo Flight Status December 15: Check full list of flights cancelled from major airports today
description: Indigo Flight Status Today: IndiGo today cancelled more than 30 flights from Delhi Airport alone due to dense fog conditions and bad weather prevailing in the national capital. On the other hand, flights from the Goa and Coimbatore airports were cancelled today. IndiGo has been hit by a severe crisis and the airline is trying to bring back its flight operations on track.

title: IndiGo's senior expat official said to face action over operational meltdown
description: DGCA's panel of inspectors has identified weaknesses in IndiGo's operations, with a top executive under scrutiny. The airline's operations control center is a major concern, leading to two-day pilot rosters and flight cancellations, exacerbated by low visibility across North India. Other airlines are assessing the situation to potentially increase capacity.

title: Maruti Suzuki says will localise EV components in next few years
description: Maruti Suzuki plans to localise battery production and key EV components over the next few years as it prepares to launch its first electric vehicle, the e-Vitara, in India next year. The company aims to boost buyer confidence by strengthening charging infrastructure, after-sales support and resale assurance.

title: Golden Growth Fund deploys Rs 58 crore in South Delhi luxury floor projects, eyes ₹400 crore fundraise
description: Golden Growth Fund, a Category II AIF targeting South and Lutyens Delhi, has deployed ₹58 crore to acquire land for luxury floor projects in Anand Niketan and Niti Bagh, with an estimated sales potential of ₹85 crore. The fund, aiming to raise ₹400 crore, reported a 28.68% IRR as of June 2025, amid rising demand and prices for luxury independent floors in South Delhi.

title: From Tesla to Porsche: The winners and losers of 2025 in cars
description: The automotive year 2025 marked a boom for supercars and luxury vehicles, with brands like Ferrari, Bugatti and Lamborghini enjoying strong demand, high profits and long waiting lists, even as many mass-market automakers struggled. EV adoption grew slower than expected, hurting companies such as Tesla, Lucid and especially Porsche, whose electric models failed to gain traction

title: IndiGo Chaos: SC declines hearing on flight cancellations, directs petitioner to Delhi HC
description: The Supreme Court has directed a petitioner seeking intervention in IndiGo's flight cancellations to approach the Delhi High Court. The High Court is already hearing a similar case concerning the crisis. IndiGo has faced criticism for cancelling hundreds of flights, stranding thousands of passengers. The DGCA has formed an expert committee to address the issues.

title: Etihad Airways Delhi-Abu Dhabi flight faces delay due to dense fog
description: Etihad Airways flight EY219 to Abu Dhabi experienced a delay on December 15 due to dense fog impacting northern India. The airline cited adverse weather conditions and assured passengers that their safety and comfort are paramount. Airport officials noted reduced visibility below operational limits, leading to flight disruptions across several north Indian airports.

title: ACME says 300 MW solar project in Rajasthan facing no evacuation constraints
description: ACME Solar's 300 MW solar project in Rajasthan is operating at full capacity. The project has secured long-term transmission access. This ensures no evacuation issues for ACME. The commissioning of a new transmission line has also eased constraints for other solar projects in Rajasthan. ACME Solar is a major renewable energy producer.

title: 360 ONE raises Rs 2,300 cr fund through real assets platform
description: 360 ONE Asset Management has raised about ₹2,300 crore through a Category II alternative investment fund focused on infrastructure and income-generating commercial real estate. The fund has largely been deployed across assets such as Knowledge Realty Trust and Brookfield-backed Bluegrass Business Park, in partnership with global investors. Its real assets platform now manages around ₹10,000 crore.

title: Govt set to introduce Bill to hike FDI in insurance sector to 100% in Parliament
description: The Indian government is set to introduce a bill to raise FDI in the insurance sector to 100%, aiming for universal insurance by 2047. The proposed legislation will also allow mergers of non-insurance companies with insurance entities and establish a Policyholders' Education and Protection Fund.

title: Delhi Weather: 60 flights cancelled from Delhi Airport amid dense fog in national capital, 5 diverted
description: Delhi NCR Weather Today: Delhi Airport announced 60 flight cancellations and 5 diversions. Several airlines including Air India and IndiGo warned passengers about disruptions. Airport officials are assisting passengers across terminals. This is the first major fog spell of winter affecting North India's airports.

title: Lords Mark Industries Ltd.–Renalyx approved to manufacture Class C AI-based haemodialysis machines; earns global CE marking
description: Lords Mark Industries Ltd. has achieved a significant feat by securing a CDSCO license to produce Class C AI-based smart haemodialysis machines, bolstering India's healthcare tech self-reliance.  This innovation, also CE-marked, signifies a global leap in advanced renal care, positioning India as a leader in sophisticated medical equipment manufacturing.

title: Delhi Weather: 60 flights cancelled, 250 delayed from Delhi Airport amid dense fog in national capital
description: Dense fog blanketed Delhi today, leading to significant disruptions at Delhi Airport. Over sixty flights were cancelled and more than two hundred fifty were delayed. Several airlines warned passengers of potential impacts. Airports across North India also experienced operational challenges. Runway visibility improved later, but some flights remained affected. Flights not equipped for advanced landing systems faced issues.

title: Thirty years of energy that moved a nation forward
description: Suzlon’s three-decade journey mirrors the evolution of India’s renewable energy ambitions. Founded in 1995 as a textile business that pivoted to wind power, the company grew rapidly to global prominence through landmark projects, a blockbuster IPO and strategic acquisitions. After navigating financial headwinds and restructuring, Suzlon made a decisive return to its roots with an India-first strategy. Today, strengthened by improved finances and renewed focus on domestic manufacturing, Suzlon stands as a symbol of resilience, reinvention and India’s push towards a self-reliant, sustainable energy future.

title: India's vegetable oil imports fall 28 per cent to 11.83 lakh tonne in November as palmolein shipments slide
description: India's vegetable oil imports saw a significant drop of 28% in November. This decline was primarily driven by a sharp decrease in refined palmolein shipments. Overall palm oil imports also reduced. However, crude palm oil and canola oil imports saw an increase. Sowing of winter oilseed crops has risen. Edible oil stocks are lower than the previous month.

title: Tata Power eyes Rs 1.25 trillion capex till FY30 with 30 GW capacity
description: Tata Power plans a significant capital expenditure of Rs 1.25 trillion from FY26-30, with 65% dedicated to clean energy projects. The company aims to reach 30 GW production capacity by FY30, including 20 GW of green energy.  This expansion is projected to generate Rs 1 lakh crore in revenue and Rs 10,000 crore in PAT by FY30.

title: India holds road shows to explore share sale in state-run GIC, sources say
description: The Indian government held roadshows in London to gauge investor interest for a minority stake sale in state-run General Insurance Corp of India (GIC). This move is part of a plan to sell a total of 10% stake in the insurer to meet regulatory public shareholding norms. Officials met investors to seek feedback on the divestment strategy.

title: Wheels India inks pact with Japan's Topy Industries for aluminium alloy wheels
description: Wheels India has entered a technical assistance agreement with Japan’s Topy Industries to enhance its design, development, and manufacturing of aluminium alloy wheels. Topy will provide engineering support and technical know-how to strengthen Wheels India’s capabilities in the cast aluminium wheel segment. The company aims to leverage this expertise to win new business, including from Japanese OEMs in India.

title: Oil tanker rates to stay strong into 2026 as sanctions remove ships for hire
description: Daily oil shipping rates have surged to three-year highs, driven by strong demand and a shrinking supply of available vessels. Nearly 44% of the global VLCC fleet is over 15 years old, while over 900 tankers face Western sanctions, contributing to elevated costs expected to persist into early 2026.

title: JioStar appoints G R Arun Kumar as CFO
description: JioStar has appointed G R Arun Kumar as its new Chief Financial Officer, bringing nearly three decades of extensive experience in finance, strategy, and operations. He will spearhead the company's Finance and Commercial functions, aiming to drive growth, profitability, and financial resilience. Kumar previously served as Group CFO and Head of Strategy at the Welspun Group.

title: 2026 MG Hector facelift launched in India: Prices start at Rs 11.99 lakh; check details
description: MG Motor 2026 Facelift launched: JSW MG Motor India has launched the 2026 MG Hector facelift, starting at Rs 11.99 lakh, and the Hector Plus from Rs 17.29 lakh. This second major refresh brings updated styling, a new 14-inch touchscreen with gesture controls, and enhanced safety features, while retaining existing powertrains. Bookings are now open for the petrol variants.

title: India emerging as preferred destination for data centres due to strong power grid: Piyush Goyal
description: India has the potential to become a preferred global destination for data centres, supported by a strong and integrated national power grid and a transformed energy sector, Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal said Monday, during a media interaction.

title: Three popular hospitality groups win bid to build luxury resorts in Andamans
description: Four flagship eco-tourism projects are set for the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. Three hospitality groups will build luxury eco-friendly resorts on Long Island, Aves Island, and Shaheed Dweep. The existing Megapode Resort in Sri Vijaya Puram will also be developed. These projects aim for sustainable, nature-centric tourism, meeting international standards.

title: MUFG is said to near deal for stake in Shriram Finance
description: Japanese financial giant MUFG is close to acquiring a significant stake in India's Shriram Finance. The deal could be worth over 500 billion yen. This move signals growing foreign investment in India's booming financial sector. Shriram Finance offers loans for commercial vehicles, tractors, and SMEs. Talks are advanced, with an agreement potentially coming soon.

title: After shrimps, another Indian sector is braving Trump tariffs
description: Indian gems and jewellery exports are showing resilience against steep US tariffs. While the US market remains sluggish, demand is picking up in Hong Kong, China, and the Middle East. This diversification is helping to offset slowdowns. Similar to the seafood sector, gems and jewellery exporters are finding alternative demand centres.

title: SHANTI Bill: Govt tables bill to open up nuclear sector for pvt cos in Lok Sabha
description: India's Parliament is considering the SHANTI Bill. This legislation aims to repeal old nuclear energy laws. It will allow private companies to invest in nuclear power. The bill promotes small modular reactors. This will ensure round-the-clock clean electricity. Solar, wind, and nuclear power will meet India's energy needs.

title: From offices to data centres, Indian real estate braces for broader growth in 2026
description: India's real estate sector is poised for robust growth in 2026, driven by strong domestic consumption and sustained investor confidence. The market is expanding across commercial, residential, and industrial segments, with alternative asset classes like data centers and co-living attracting significant institutional interest. Evolving workplace strategies and infrastructure development are key growth drivers.

title: Ranveer Singh-starrer 'Dhurandhar' storms past Rs 550 crore mark at worldwide box office
description: Filmmaker Aditya Dhar's espionage drama 'Dhurandhar' has become a global box office sensation. The Ranveer Singh-starrer has collected Rs 552.70 crore worldwide in just 10 days. The film recorded the biggest Sunday ever for a Hindi movie on its second Sunday. 'Dhurandhar' has registered record-breaking collections for its second Friday, Saturday, and Sunday in Hindi cinema history.

title: Fortis launches facility for mental healthcare; plans 10 centres over 3 yrs
description: Fortis Healthcare has opened Adayu, a new mental healthcare hospital in Gurugram. This facility is the first of ten planned across India within three years. It aims to provide comprehensive psychiatric care. The initiative addresses a significant gap in mental health infrastructure and professional availability in the country. Fortis is committed to improving mental well-being.

title: TV retains edge among affluent India as brand equity slips for FMCG majors
description: Despite a growing affluent consumer base, large FMCG brands face declining penetration and volume share in India. A Kantar study highlights television's continued power in building brand equity and reach among these households, outperforming digital platforms in attention and comprehension for long-term brand building.

title: Content fatigue emerges as early fault line in India’s fast-growing micro-drama market
description: India's micro-drama market is experiencing rapid growth, reaching $260 million annually, but faces challenges. Content fatigue due to repetitive storylines and slow refresh cycles is impacting user retention, with supply-side strain hindering content creation to meet rising demand. Future growth hinges on improving content velocity, quality, and monetization resilience.

title: Bombay High Court quashes arbitration award against Thermax, orders RCF to refund Rs 218 crore
description: The Bombay High Court has overturned an arbitral award, ordering Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilisers (RCF) to refund Rs 218 crore to Thermax Ltd. The court cited the arbitrator's failure to provide reasons and base findings on evidence as grounds for setting aside the award. RCF intends to challenge the ruling.

title: MG Hector Facelift launched at Rs 11.19 lakh: What’s new in the 2026 model
description: Three new bills have been introduced in the Lok Sabha, including one to open the civil nuclear sector to private players. The SHANTI Bill aims to overhaul the liability regime and grant statutory status to the Atomic Energy Regulatory Board. Additionally, a bill was introduced to repeal 71 outdated laws.

title: Indigo Flight Status December 16: Over 50 flights cancelled; check full list from major airports today
description: IndiGo has issued an advisory to passengers. Weather conditions may slow down flight movements. Passengers are asked to plan ahead and check their flight status before heading to the airport. The airline is monitoring the situation closely. Efforts are underway to ensure passenger comfort during any waiting times. IndiGo thanks passengers for their understanding.

title: HDFC Bank gets approval to acquire up to 9.5% stake in IndusInd Bank
description: HDFC Bank has secured RBI approval for its group entities to collectively hold up to 9.50% in IndusInd Bank. This approval, valid for one year until December 14, 2026, allows for aggregate investments by entities like HDFC Mutual Fund and HDFC Life. The bank sought this increase as combined group investments were projected to exceed the previous 5% limit.

title: Masdar pulls the plug on going private with ReNew
description: Masdar has withdrawn its nearly $1 billion offer to take ReNew Energy Global private, causing a significant drop in the company's stock price. The move by the leading investor in a four-member consortium effectively terminates the proposed transaction, disappointing shareholders seeking an exit opportunity.

title: Dream11 exits IPL jerseys as teams sign new principal sponsors
description: Several IPL franchises are set to unveil new principal sponsors for the upcoming season, with deals priced 15-20% higher than previous contracts. This shift sees legacy brands like Birla Estates and Hero Vida replacing gaming companies such as Dream11, reflecting a recalibration in cricket sponsorships.

title: Delhi HC bars RSPL's Leayan Global from using 'power flex' for footwear
description: Upholding the order passed by its single-judge bench in 2019, Justice C Hari Shankar and Justice Om Prakash Shukla of a division bench said there is a deceptive similarity between Kanpur-based Leayan Global's "Power Flex" mark and Bata India's "Power" mark, and both marks were being used for goods which are similar, thus there is a likelihood of confusion.

title: Trial by fire: Over 60% of pharma SMEs may be forced to shut shop
description: India is estimated to have about 12,000 drug manufacturing units. The units that risk being shut down account for about Rs 75,000 crore of India's Rs 2.5 lakh crore domestic drug market, the executives said. This may result in shortages of antibiotics, anti-hypertensives, anti-inflammatory medicines, analgesic, anti-cough and cold tablets, diabetes drugs and general medicines, among others, said a pharma industry expert, speaking on the condition of anonymity.

title: Cyber cover rush gathers pace as digital risks mount
description: The time taken to put a cyber insurance cover in place has shrunk dramatically to just a few days from six to seven months earlier, as companies move quickly to hedge against operational disruption, regulatory fines and potential indemnification exposure, said insurers and brokers.

title: Winter fog disrupts air travel as 300 flights cancelled across north India
description: Dense winter fog blanketed north India on Monday, leading to the cancellation of at least 300 flights and hundreds of delays. Delhi airport alone saw 228 flights cancelled due to low visibility, impacting thousands of passengers. Airlines like IndiGo and Air India confirmed significant disruptions, with affected customers being notified.

title: SC rejects plea seeking probe, refunds over IndiGo flight chaos
description: The Supreme Court declined to hear a public interest litigation concerning mass IndiGo flight cancellations. The court directed the petitioner to approach the Delhi High Court, which is already addressing the issue. Thousands of passengers were stranded due to the cancellations.

title: Natural gas loses industrial buyers as liquid fuels turn cheaper
description: City gas distributors are facing challenges acquiring new industrial and commercial customers due to natural gas being costlier than competing liquid fuels. New factory connections dropped 39% and commercial additions fell 17% in the first half of the financial year, as cheaper LPG and propane are displacing natural gas.

title: IndusInd Bank moves to claw back bonuses from ex-top brass
description: The bank has not yet finalised the clawback period, which is likely to span two to three years. The proposed action is based on findings from multiple internal and external reports commissioned by the bank, including reviews conducted by Grant Thornton, PwC and EY, they said. The three executives were at the helm of IndusInd when the non-state bank discovered accounting discrepancies in internal derivative trades, which caused it a loss of about Rs 2,000 crore.

title: Defaults on the rise in micro loans over property
description: According to the report, delinquency levels in the micro-LAP segment rose by 45 basis points (bps) year-on-year to 3.3% as of September 2025. Early delinquencies-measured as loans 90 days or more past due within 12 months on book-increased by 29 bps YoY to 2.2% for originations in the quarter ended September 2024. This is significantly higher than overall LAP early delinquencies of 1.6%.

title: Deduction on foreign bank's 'head office expenditure' capped at 5% of income: Supreme Court
description: If any foreign company operating in India incurs any expenses outside India but that is also related to Indian business, Section 44C allows the deduction for that expense, but it is subject to the restriction provided in the provision. The restriction limits the expense to the tune of 5% of adjusted total income of the Indian business, it said.

title: Cloud is the limit for Hyderabad's office market now
description: Hyderabad's property market is set for a boom. Major tech companies are investing billions in cloud and AI infrastructure across India. This will boost demand for office spaces and land. Hyderabad, with its supportive policies and infrastructure, is a key beneficiary. This trend will reshape India's real estate and digital infrastructure landscape.

title: Win Diesel: M&M sells half the cars using the fuel in India now
description: The XUV700 and Thar maker dominates the diesel PV market, with its share projected to increase to 56% this year, from 53% in 2024 and 34% in 2022, according to Equirus Research data.

title: Gold surges ₹4,000 to record ₹137,600
description: Gold prices have reached a record high of Rs 1,37,600 per 10 grams in New Delhi. This surge follows firm global cues and renewed safe-haven demand. International spot gold also saw a significant rise. Silver prices remained stable. Gold imports saw a dip in November after a substantial increase in October.

title: Clean air, open land redraw luxury housing demand in India
description: Wealthy Indians are buying their second homes outside cities. Clean air and less crowded living are now priorities. Destinations like Goa and Alibaug are seeing more interest. These homes are used for longer stays and remote work. Developers are responding with more low-density projects. This trend is changing the luxury housing market.

title: Star Air considering $1 billion Embraer jet purchase
description: The purchase would mark the first by the airline that’s owned by the Sanjay Ghodawat Group, which has interests in areas spanning consumer products, education, retail and mining.

title: Battery energy storage cost falls to Rs 2.1/unit from Rs 10.18 in 2022-23: Power Min
description: Battery energy storage system (BESS) costs have plummeted to Rs 2.1 per unit from Rs 10.18 per unit, as reported to Parliament. The government is actively promoting affordability through Viability Gap Funding schemes and waivers on transmission charges. Additionally, a Production-Linked Incentive scheme aims to boost domestic manufacturing, reducing import dependency and future BESS costs.

title: SBI plans to double YONO users after launching new version
description: India's largest bank also plans to put 10,000 people on the ground to guide people to transition to the digital banking application as it pushes towards a uniform application on the mobile, web and branch banking.

title: Tata Power looks at Rs 25,000 crore annual capex till FY30: CEO Praveer Sinha
description: Tata Power plans a significant capital expenditure of Rs 25,000 crore annually until FY30, with 65% dedicated to clean energy projects. The company aims to nearly triple its clean and green capacity to 20 GW by March 2031 and expand its customer base in the distribution segment to 40 million by 2030.

title: Tata Power may explore 20-50 MW small modular projects after amended nuclear-related law: CEO Sinha
description: Tata Power is set to explore small modular reactor projects of 20-50 megawatt capacity. This move follows proposed legal amendments to allow private participation in India's nuclear sector. The company is already scouting locations for future nuclear ventures. While new plants will take time to materialize, the government aims for 100 GW nuclear capacity by 2047.

title: Star Air to launch flight services from Navi Mumbai airport
description: Star Air begins flight operations from Navi Mumbai International Airport on December 25. The airline will connect Navi Mumbai to Ahmedabad, Goa Mopa, Bengaluru, and Nanded. This new service offers seamless travel to key business and leisure destinations in western and southern India. Flights will utilize Embraer 175 aircraft for these new routes.

title: EIH Limited announces The Oberoi, Makaibari Tea Estate, Darjeeling
description: The Oberoi Group will open a new luxury resort at the historic Makaibari Tea Estate in Darjeeling. The property is set to open in 2030. The resort will be located near Bagdogra International Airport. It aims to blend luxury with the estate's rich heritage and natural beauty.

title: Hyundai Motor India shareholders approve appointment of Tarun Garg as MD & CEO
description: Hyundai Motor India Ltd shareholders have approved Tarun Garg's appointment as MD and CEO from January 1, 2026. This move aligns with Hyundai Motor Co's Rs 45,000 crore investment plan for India by FY30, including new product launches and the entry of Hyundai Capital and Genesis.

title: Reliance Jio unveils 'Happy New Year 2026' recharge plans with unlimited 5G and OTT benefits
description: Reliance Jio unveils its Happy New Year 2026 recharge plans. These offers include annual and monthly options with unlimited 5G data. Users also receive popular OTT subscriptions and a limited-period Google Gemini Pro offer. A Flexi Pack provides data and customized entertainment bundles. These plans target users seeking high data, entertainment, and AI services.

title: Vinitaly India Roadshow: VeronaFiere eyes long India road for Italian wine and other products
description: VeronaFiere is strengthening its commitment to the Indian market with the second Vinitaly Roadshow, aiming for long-term development of Italian wine and "Made in Italy" products. The initiative, supported by a growing Indian middle class and potential EU-India trade agreements, seeks to foster relationships between Italian wineries and international buyers.

title: RBL Bank CFO Buvanesh Tharashankar resigns
description: RBL Bank's Chief Financial Officer, Buvanesh Tharashankar, has resigned effective December 15, 2025, to pursue external opportunities. The bank has accepted his resignation and appointed an interim successor as per its succession plan. Formalities for a permanent replacement are underway.

title: DGCA probe panel on flight disruptions visits IndiGo headquarters
description: A four-member panel appointed by the Director General of Civil Aviation visited IndiGo's headquarters to investigate recent large-scale operational disruptions. The panel examined various operational aspects, including infrastructure, manpower planning, rostering, and pilot duty norms, to identify the root causes of the widespread service interruptions.

title: SBI appoints Ravi Ranjan as managing director
description: State Bank of India has appointed Ravi Ranjan as its new managing director, effective December 15, 2025. Ranjan, previously a deputy managing director, will serve until his superannuation on September 30, 2028. The Central government made the appointment, and Ranjan is not disqualified from holding the position.

title: Mizoram: Northeast Frontier Railway successfully handles first-ever direct inward automobile rake at Sairang Station
description: A total of 119 Maruti cars, transported from Changsari near Guwahati, were delivered by rail, marking a historic step in strengthening logistics connectivity to the State.

title: Big guys are putting their money where your mouth is
description: India's food and beverages sector is seeing intense dealmaking as urbanisation and rising incomes reshape the market. Reliance Industries and Orkla India and others are actively pursuing acquisitions, while private equity firms are investing heavily in scaled, brand-led food businesses.

title: Texmaco Rail bags Rs 132cr wagon supply order from Touax JV
description: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Ltd has secured a Rs 132-crore order from its joint venture, Touax Texmaco Railcar Leasing Pvt Ltd, for the supply of BLSS and BVCM wagons. The delivery of these rakes is scheduled to be completed by July 2026, reinforcing the company's manufacturing capabilities and supporting India's sustainable logistics goals.

title: South Seas Distilleries launches world's first Mahua spirit finished single malt
description: The Maharashtra based company operates India’s largest copper pot stills and maintains one of the country’s oldest private cask inventories. It traces its operations back more than a century, launching the new brand Madhuca under Crazy Cock’s existing portfolio that also includes Dhua and Rare.

title: Maruti Suzuki's e-Vitara pricing will not disappoint, says Partho Banerjee
description: Maruti Suzuki assures customers that the upcoming e-Vitara electric vehicle's pricing will be worth the wait. The company will allow test drives before bookings open, a first for the Indian market. The made-in-India e-Vitara, already performing well in the UK, boasts a 543 km range and a dedicated EV platform for enhanced cabin space.

title: Delhivery launches on-demand intra-city shipping service in Mumbai, Hyderabad
description: Delhivery has officially debuted its rapid intra-city shipping service in both Mumbai and Hyderabad, revolutionizing local delivery options. Through the user-friendly Delhivery Direct App, customers can easily book pickups in as little as 15 minutes, perfect for small businesses and everyday individuals looking for quick local deliveries. Plus, the app simplifies intercity shipping throughout India.

title: Mumbai Airport issues travel advisory as heavy fog in North India impacts flight operations
description: Dense fog in Northern India is causing flight disruptions. Mumbai Airport has issued an advisory for passengers. Travelers are urged to check flight status before leaving for the airport. Airlines and airport authorities are working to minimize delays. Safety remains the top priority for all operations.

title: DGCA tariff monitoring unit to be strengthened as government targets high airfares: Aviation minister
description: The government is actively addressing high airfares by strengthening the DGCA's tariff monitoring unit to prevent opportunistic pricing. Minister Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu informed the Rajya Sabha that efforts are underway to ensure smooth air travel for passengers, even in a deregulated sector. The ministry is closely monitoring domestic and international routes to keep fares reasonable and affordable.

title: The math of fuel taxes: Why your daily commute costs more in Amaravati than Delhi
description: Andhra Pradesh records the highest petrol and diesel prices due to its elevated VAT, while Andaman & Nicobar Islands offer the lowest fuel costs.  This disparity arises from varying state VAT rates and freight charges, as highlighted by the Minister of State for Petroleum and Natural Gas.

title: Indigo flights crisis: Supreme Court asks PIL petitioner to approach Delhi HC
description: The Supreme Court has directed a lawyer to approach the Delhi High Court regarding the Indigo flight crisis. The apex court noted that the Delhi High Court is already hearing the matter. The petitioner can join the ongoing proceedings there. The Supreme Court clarified that if any new issues arise, parties can approach them. The petitioner agreed to the suggestion.

title: Sagarmala Finance Corporation to start lending soon: MD
description: The total authorized capital of SMFCL is Rs 1,000 crore and its paid-up share capital is Rs.1,000 crore. Total equity investment as on March 31, 2024 stood at Rs.541.79 crore. The NBFC handed over a cheque of Rs 15.88 crore to the centre as the Final Dividend for fiscal 2024-25.

title: BCCI not recognised as a national sports body, says sports minister Mandaviya
description: Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya stated in the Lok Sabha that the BCCI is not a recognised National Sports Federation (NSF). This status is expected to change with the new National Sports Governance Act next year, which mandates NSFs to register for central government funding and accountability.

title: Tata Sierra bookings open: Price, variants, engine options and delivery timeline
description: Tata Motors has opened bookings for the new Sierra SUV, with prices ranging from Rs 11.49 lakh to Rs 21.29 lakh. Deliveries are set to commence in January 2026, and the vehicle boasts a range of modern features and powertrain options. The Sierra enters a competitive segment, challenging established mid-size SUVs.

title: Pakistan seeks oil deal with Russia as energy ministries hold talks, RIA reports
description: Russia and Pakistan are discussing a potential oil-sector agreement covering exploration, production and refining, according to Pakistan’s Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb. Talks are currently underway between the two countries’ energy ministries, and Russia has also proposed upgrading a refinery in Pakistan.

title: Inox Wind secures repeat 100 MW wind order from Jakson Green
description: Inox Wind has secured a repeat order for 100 MW of 3.3 MW turbines from Jakson Green for projects in Gujarat. This brings Inox Wind's total order inflow for FY26 to 600 MW. The company will also provide EPC and O&M services for the project.

title: Tata Power to finalise Rs 6,500-cr wafer-ingot project by January: CEO Praveer Sinha
description: Tata Power is set to finalize its massive 10 GW wafer and ingot project by January next year. This significant Rs 6,500 crore investment aims to complete the company's solar manufacturing integration. Discussions are underway with states like Odisha, Tamil Nadu, and Andhra Pradesh. Final location will be announced soon, following a review of state policies and incentives.

title: Dharma Productions buys out Cornerstone stake in talent venture, rebrands agency as DCAA
description: Dharma Productions has acquired Cornerstone's stake in its talent management arm. The company is now Dharma Collab Artists Agency, or DCAA. This new agency will represent talent across film, music, sports, digital media, and live entertainment. Uday Singh Gauri will continue as CEO.

title: Carbon capture offers low-cost steel emissions cut, finds study
description: A joint study by Climate Policy Initiative and Dastur Energy suggests that capturing and reusing emitted carbon could be the most cost-effective way to decarbonize India's steel industry. While requiring significant investment, Carbon Capture, Utilisation, and Storage (CCUS) is projected to be cheaper than hydrogen or natural gas-based methods for steel production.

title: Apple foldable iPhone leak reveals Touch ID, a creaseless display and hinge details
description: Apple's foldable iPhone is expected by fall 2026. Leaks suggest a thin, durable design with a side fingerprint sensor. This device aims to solve display crease issues. Apple's entry could significantly boost the foldable phone market. Analysts predict it will be a premium device, potentially priced around $2,000.

title: Parliament Winter Session: Govt tables bill to hike FDI in insurance sector to 100% in Lok Sabha
description: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman introduced a bill in Lok Sabha to raise FDI in the insurance sector to 100 percent. This move aims to ensure insurance coverage for all citizens by 2047. The proposed legislation will amend key insurance-related acts.

title: India’s real estate momentum sustained by commercial, residential demand in 2025
description: India's real estate sector experienced robust growth in 2025. Strong economic momentum and stable policies fueled demand across residential, commercial, and logistics. Premium housing led the market. Office spaces saw significant absorption, with flexible workspaces expanding rapidly.

title: Why are so many Indian hospitals rushing to the market?
description: India's healthcare sector is poised for a significant IPO boom in 2026, with hospitals and allied services expected to raise Rs 20,000 crore. This surge is driven by improving financials, strong demand due to underpenetration, and private equity backing.  Specialty care and medical tourism also fuel this growth, making public markets a strategic avenue for expansion.

title: B Sairam takes charge as Coal India CMD
description: B Sairam has assumed the role of Chairman and Managing Director at Coal India Limited. This appointment occurs as CIL intensifies efforts to meet record production targets amidst rising domestic energy demand. Sairam brings extensive experience in mining engineering and energy management. He previously led CIL's Northern Coalfields Ltd. The company is also exploring solar power and critical mineral acquisitions.

title: Tata Sierra bookings open: Know Complete Price, variants, engine options and delivery timeline
description: Tata Sierra bookings officially open: Tata Motors has opened bookings for the new Sierra SUV, with prices ranging from Rs 11.49 lakh to Rs 21.29 lakh. Deliveries are set to commence in January 2026, and the vehicle boasts a range of modern features and powertrain options. The Sierra enters a competitive segment, challenging established mid-size SUVs.

title: FMCG demand shows signs of recovery as GST-led price cuts lift volumes: ICICI Bank
description: Fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) companies in India are witnessing signs of demand recovery, supported by recent GST-linked price cuts and higher promotional activity, according to a report by ICICI Bank.

title: GST cuts yet to fully lift FMCG demand as consumers prioritise big-ticket buys
description: The FMCG sector is observing the effects of recent GST rate reductions. Consumers initially focused on larger purchases like cars and durables. Savings on everyday items were less noticeable. Industry leaders anticipate a clearer picture of growth in the coming quarters.

title: Michael Bay to collaborate with Bhanushali Studios on Indian film project
description: Hollywood filmmaker Michael Bay is collaborating with Bhanushali Studios for an upcoming Indian feature film. Directed by Anthony D’Souza with music by A.R. Rahman, the project aims to merge Hollywood-scale action with Indian storytelling. This marks Bay's first creative partnership with an Indian studio as Bhanushali Studios continues its global expansion.

title: Lodha Developers-MRG group to build 2 projects in Gurugram with revenue potential of Rs 3,600 crore
description: Lodha Developers is entering the Delhi-NCR market through a partnership with MRG Group. They will develop two projects in Gurugram. These projects have a combined revenue potential exceeding Rs 3,600 crore. The developments aim to set new standards for premium commercial and residential spaces in the region.

title: IHH Healthcare to expand India capacity to 7,000 beds by 2028
description: IHH Healthcare is set to significantly boost its Indian capacity to approximately 7,000 beds by 2028, following a stake increase in Fortis Healthcare. This expansion, aiming for an additional 2,000 beds, will leverage synergies between Fortis and Gleneagles Healthcare India to enhance patient care and operational efficiency across its 35 hospitals nationwide.

title: Vedanta gets NCLT nod for demerger plan
description: Vedanta said on Tuesday that the National Company Law Tribunal has approved its demerger plan to split the oil-to-metals conglomerate into separate listed entities.

title: Lodha Developers ties up with MRG Group for NCR entry
description: Lodha Developers is entering the Delhi-NCR market through a partnership with MRG Group. They will develop two projects in Gurugram. These projects have a combined revenue potential exceeding Rs 3,600 crore. The developments aim to set new standards for premium commercial and residential spaces in the region.

title: CAG flags delays in development of 3,000 MW solar projects by Coal India
description: Government auditor CAG has criticised Coal India Ltd for significant delays in its 3,000 MW solar power project development. By December 2024, only 122.492 MW had been installed, a mere 4.08% of the target. CAG urges Coal India to expedite these projects to achieve Net Zero energy status.

title: Citroen sees 3-fold sequential jump in India sales in December quarter; exports up 18.8%
description: Citroen India has seen a remarkable three-fold increase in sales growth during the December quarter. The brand is a key contributor to Stellantis Group's exports from India, which have grown by 18.8 percent this year.

title: Govt says 7.71 lakh households got zero electricity bills under PM's Muft Bijli Yojana
description: The PM Surya Ghar scheme has brought zero electricity bills to over 7.7 lakh homes.  The PM-KUSUM initiative empowers farmers, turning them into energy providers.  The National Green Hydrogen Mission is awarding significant manufacturing and production capacities.  These government schemes are actively benefiting citizens and driving renewable energy adoption across India.

title: Why the next wave of SaaS will be built around workflows, not features
description: The SaaS industry is shifting from feature-heavy products to workflow-first solutions as enterprises prioritize seamless integration into daily operations. This evolution, driven by software fatigue and a demand for measurable productivity, sees AI embedded to streamline tasks and reduce friction. Future SaaS success will hinge on deep operational impact rather than sheer feature count.

title: Morgan Stanley predicts 16-20% telecom tariff jump in Q1 FY27
description: This will be the fourth major price hike in eight years. The industry raised prices by 15% in 2024, 20% in 2021, and 30% in 2019. According to Morgan Stanlley, each time strong players like Airtel captured bigger revenue gains, weaker competitors fell behind.

title: Railways should diversify freight earnings: Parliamentary Committee
description: In a bid to innovate and expand, Indian Railways is encouraged to expand its freight operations beyond just coal, iron ore, and cement. The Standing Committee on Railways emphasised the need to actively connect with industries like FMCG and e-commerce. To pave the way for future dedicated freight corridors, attracting private investments will be instrumental, recommended Parliamentary Committee.

title: Saregama ties up with Sanjay Leela Bhansali’s Bhansali Productions for exclusive music rights
description: Saregama India has partnered with Bhansali Productions. This deal grants Saregama exclusive music rights for all future Bhansali films. Saregama is also investing in Bhansali Productions. This collaboration aims to secure premium film music.

title: Shriram Finance board meet on Friday likely to finalise MUFG deal
description: Shriram Finance's board will convene to consider a potential equity stake sale to Japan's MUFG, with reports indicating advanced talks for a 20% stake valued at approximately Rs 23,200 crore. This move signifies growing Japanese interest in Indian financial services and could represent the largest FDI in the NBFC sector to date.

title: IndiGo flight status December 17: Check list of cancelled flights from major Indian airports today
description: IndiGo cancelled flights December 17: IndiGo flight cancellations continued on Wednesday at the Chennai Airport due to dense fog conditions and bad weather. A total of 11 flights, including arrival and departure, were cancelled at the Chennai Airport today. IndiGo has also issued an advisory for passengers that flight operations will be affected today.

title: IndiGo overtakes Air India group in international passengers after June crash
